s0201.literal: On xinhai day Wu Mingche captured Qinzhou's water barrier.
s0201.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wu Mingche captured the water barrier at Qinzhou.

s0202.literal: On gengshen day Qi sent a hundred thousand men to relieve Liyang; Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Huang Faqu defeated them.
s0202.idiomatic: On gengshen day Northern Qi sent a hundred thousand men to relieve Liyang; Huang Faqu, equal in honor to the three dukes, routed them.

s0203.literal: On xinyou day Qi troops came to relieve Qinzhou; Wu Mingche defeated them again.
s0203.idiomatic: On xinyou day Qi forces marched to relieve Qinzhou; Wu Mingche defeated them again.

s0204.literal: On guihai day an edict ordered that Qi soldiers killed by the northern campaign armies be buried.
s0204.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered the northern expedition to bury all Qi dead.

s0205.literal: On jiazi day Administrator of Nanchen Xu Shan captured Shiliang city.
s0205.idiomatic: On jiazi day Xu Shan, administrator of Nanchen, took Shiliang city.

s0206.literal: In the fifth month, on jisi day, Waliang city surrendered.
s0206.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jisi day, Waliang city surrendered.

s0207.literal: On guiyou day Yangping commandery city surrendered.
s0207.idiomatic: On guiyou day the city of Yangping commandery surrendered.

s0208.literal: On jiaxu day Xu Shan captured Luzhou commandery city.
s0208.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xu Shan took Luzhou commandery city.

s0209.literal: On jingzi day Huang Faqu captured Liyang city.
s0209.idiomatic: On jingzi day Huang Faqu took Liyang city.

s0210.literal: On jimao day North Gaotang commandery city surrendered.
s0210.idiomatic: On jimao day the city of North Gaotang commandery surrendered.

s0211.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered Campaign North Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of South Yuzhou Huang Faqu to move his garrison to Liyang; counties Qi had changed into commanderies were all restored.
s0211.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict moved Huang Faqu, campaign north grand general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Yuzhou, to garrison Liyang and restored counties Northern Qi had raised to commanderies.

s0212.literal: On yiyou day Administrator of South Qichang Huang Yong captured the outer wall of Qichang city.
s0212.idiomatic: On yiyou day Huang Yong, administrator of South Qichang, took the outer wall of Qichang city.

s0213.literal: On jingxu day Administrator of Luling Ren Zhong's army reached Dongguan, captured its east and west cities, and advanced to capture Qichou city.
s0213.idiomatic: On jingxu day Ren Zhong, administrator of Luling, reached Dongguan, took its eastern and western cities, and advanced to take Qichou city.

s0214.literal: On wuzi day he again captured Qiao commandery city; Qinzhou city surrendered.
s0214.idiomatic: On wuzi day he again took Qiao commandery city, and Qinzhou city surrendered.

s0215.literal: On guisi day Guabu and Husu cities surrendered.
s0215.idiomatic: On guisi day Guabu and Husu surrendered.

s0216.literal: In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Inspector of Yingzhou Li Zong captured Shunkou city.
s0216.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Li Zong, inspector of Yingzhou, took Shunkou city.

s0217.literal: On yisi day Ren Zhong captured the outer wall of Hezhou.
s0217.idiomatic: On yisi day Ren Zhong took the outer wall of Hezhou.

s0218.literal: On gengxu day Huaiyang and Shuyang commanderies both abandoned their cities and fled.
s0218.idiomatic: On gengxu day Huaiyang and Shuyang commanderies both abandoned their cities and fled.

s0219.literal: On guichou day an auspicious cloud appeared.
s0219.idiomatic: On guichou day an auspicious cloud was seen.

s0220.literal: Administrator of Yuzhang Cheng Wenji captured Jingzhou city.
s0220.idiomatic: Cheng Wenji, administrator of Yuzhang, took Jingzhou city.

s0221.literal: On yimao day Pacify Campaigns Chief Clerk Zhan Tuo captured Xincai city.
s0221.idiomatic: On yimao day Zhan Tuo, chief clerk of the pacify campaigns staff, took Xincai city.

s0224.literal: On hai day Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0224.idiomatic: On hai day Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0226.literal: Wu Mingche's army reached Renzhou; on jiazi day it captured the prefectural city.
s0226.idiomatic: Wu Mingche's army reached Renzhou; on jiazi day it took the prefectural city.

s0227.literal: That month the Bright Hall was constructed.
s0227.idiomatic: That month work began on the Bright Hall.

s0228.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou day, Garrison Front General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Wu Mingche was advanced in title to Campaign North Grand General.
s0228.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yichou day, Wu Mingche, garrison front general and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was promoted to campaign north grand general.

s0229.literal: On wuchen day Qi sent twenty thousand men to relieve Qichang; Administrator of Xiyang Zhou Jiong defeated them.
s0229.idiomatic: On wuchen day Northern Qi sent twenty thousand men to relieve Qichang; Zhou Jiong, administrator of Xiyang, routed them.

s0230.literal: On jisi day Wu Mingche's army reached Xiakou and captured the city on the north bank; the defenders on the south bank abandoned the city and fled.
s0230.idiomatic: On jisi day Wu Mingche reached Xiakou, took the north-bank city, and the south-bank garrison fled.

s0232.literal: Gentry and commoners of Jiangcheng in north of the Huai and Guyang all killed their chieftains and surrendered their cities.
s0232.idiomatic: In north Huai Jiangcheng and in Guyang, local leaders and people killed their chiefs and surrendered with the cities.

s0233.literal: On jingxu day Wu Mingche captured the outer wall of Shouyang.
s0233.idiomatic: On jingxu day Wu Mingche took the outer wall of Shouyang.

s0234.literal: In the eighth month, on yiwei day, Shanyang city surrendered.
s0234.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei day, Shanyang city surrendered.

s0235.literal: On renchen day Xuyi city surrendered.

s0236.literal: On wushen day South Qichang commandery was abolished.
s0236.idiomatic: On wushen day South Qichang commandery was abolished.

s0237.literal: On renzi day Martial-display General Xu Jingbian captured Hai'an city.
s0237.idiomatic: On renzi day Xu Jingbian, martial-display general, took Hai'an city.

s0238.idiomatic: The city of Donghai in Qingzhou surrendered.

s0239.literal: On wuwu day Marquis Pinggu Chen Jingtai and others captured Jinzhou city.
s0239.idiomatic: On wuwu day Chen Jingtai, Marquis Pinggu, and others took Jinzhou city.

s0240.literal: In the ninth month, on jiazi day, Yangping city surrendered.
s0240.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi day, Yangping surrendered.

s0241.literal: [13] On renshen day Administrator of Gaotang Shen Shandu captured Matou city.
s0241.idiomatic: [13] On renshen day Shen Shandu, administrator of Gaotang, took Matou city.

s0242.literal: [14] On jiaxu day Qi'an city surrendered.

s0243.literal: On jingzi day Left Guard General Fan Yi captured the Chuzi fort of Guangling.
s0243.idiomatic: On jingzi day Fan Yi, left guard general, took the Chuzi fort at Guangling.

s0244.literal: On guimao day Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing, Concurrent Minister of Personnel, and Commandant of Horse for the Consort Shen Junli died.
s0244.idiomatic: On guimao day Shen Junli, right ministerial aide, minister of personnel, and commandant of horse for the consort, died.

s0245.literal: On dinghai day former Administrator of Poyang Lu Tiannian captured the small city of Huangcheng; Qi troops withdrew to hold the great city.
s0245.idiomatic: On dinghai day Lu Tiannian, former administrator of Poyang, took Huangcheng's small city; Qi forces fell back on the great city.

s0246.literal: On wuzi day Xuyi commandery of South Yanzhou was detached and placed under Qiaozhou.
s0246.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xuyi commandery of South Yanzhou was placed under Qiaozhou.

s0247.literal: On renchen, the last day of the month, the night was bright.
s0247.idiomatic: On renchen, the month's last day, the night was bright.

s0249.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu day, Guomo city surrendered.
s0249.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu day, Guomo surrendered.

s0250.literal: On wuxu day Secretariat Supervisor Wang Chang was made Minister of Personnel.
s0250.idiomatic: On wuxu day Wang Chang, secretariat supervisor, was made minister of personnel.

s0251.literal: On jihai day Special Grand Master and Concurrent Director of the Directorate of Education Zhou Hongzheng was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing.
s0251.idiomatic: On jihai day Zhou Hongzheng, special grand master and concurrent director of the directorate of education, was made right ministerial aide.

s0252.literal: On yisi day Wu Mingche captured Shouyang city, beheaded Wang Lin, and sent his head to the capital; it was exposed at the Vermilion Bird landing.
s0252.idiomatic: On yisi day Wu Mingche took Shouyang, beheaded Wang Lin, and sent his head to the capital; it was displayed at the Vermilion Bird landing.

s0253.literal: On dingwei day ten thousand Qi troops reached Yingkou; Fan Yi attacked and drove them off.
s0253.idiomatic: On dingwei day ten thousand Qi troops reached Yingkou; Fan Yi attacked and drove them away.

s0254.literal: On xinhai day Qi sent troops to relieve Cangling; they were again defeated.
s0254.idiomatic: On xinhai day Northern Qi sent troops to relieve Cangling; they were defeated again.

s0255.literal: On jingchen day an edict said: "When Liang in its last days took Xuanyang, it made Shouyang South Yuzhou; now that it is recovered, it may again be Yuzhou.
s0255.idiomatic: On jingchen day an edict declared: "When Liang in its decline took Xuanyang, it made Shouyang South Yuzhou; now that it is recovered, it shall again be Yuzhou.

s0256.literal: Huangcheng is to be Sizhou; Zhixia is to be Anchang commandery, Zhantuan is to be Hanyang commandery, and the three cities following Liang are to be Yiyang commandery—all under Sizhou."
s0256.idiomatic: Huangcheng shall be Sizhou; Zhixia shall be Anchang commandery, Zhantuan Hanyang commandery, and the three cities under the Liang model shall be Yiyang commandery—all under Sizhou."

s0257.literal: Campaign North Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Wu Mingche was made Inspector of Yuzhou and advanced to Chariots-and-Cavalry Grand General;
s0257.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, campaign north grand general and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was made inspector of Yuzhou and promoted to chariots-and-cavalry grand general;

s0258.literal: Campaign South Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of South Yuzhou Huang Faqu was made Campaign West Grand General and Inspector of Hezhou.
s0258.idiomatic: Huang Faqu, campaign south grand general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Yuzhou, was made campaign west grand general and inspector of Hezhou.

s0259.literal: On wuwu day Zhan Tuo captured Qichang city.
s0259.idiomatic: On wuwu day Zhan Tuo took Qichang city.

s0260.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu day, Huaiyin city surrendered.
s0260.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu day, Huaiyin surrendered.

s0261.literal: On gengchen day Subdue-the-Barbarians General Liu Taogen captured Qushan city.
s0261.idiomatic: On gengchen day Liu Taogen, subdue-the-barbarians general, took Qushan city.

s0262.literal: [15] On xinsi day Fan Yi captured Jiyin city.
s0262.idiomatic: [15] On xinsi day Fan Yi took Jiyin city.

s0263.literal: On jichou day Lu Guangda and others captured North Xuzhou.
s0263.idiomatic: On jichou day Lu Guangda and others took North Xuzhou.

s0264.literal: On renchen, the new moon of the twelfth month, an edict said: "In antiquity those who turned on their kin and rebelled were exterminated to the clan, their heads stored away to warn later ages.
s0264.idiomatic: On renchen, the new moon of the twelfth month, an edict declared: "In antiquity rebels who turned on kin were wiped out to the clan and their heads kept to warn posterity.

s0265.literal: Of late those executed have been only the person himself; sons and grandsons may remain, and exposure on the pole suffices—they should not long rest in the armory like the Yuezhi moon.
s0265.idiomatic: Lately execution has stopped at one man; sons and grandsons may survive, and display on the pole is enough—they need not linger in the armory like the Yuezhi moon.

s0266.literal: In compassionate feeling there is benevolence one cannot bear.
s0266.idiomatic: In compassion there is a kindness one cannot bear to withhold.

s0267.literal: Xiong Tanlang, Liu Yi, Chen Baoying, Zhou Di, Deng Xu, and the like, and now Wang Lin's head—all are to be returned to their kin to extend broad pardon."
s0267.idiomatic: Xiong Tanlang, Liu Yi, Chen Baoying, Zhou Di, Deng Xu, and the like, and now Wang Lin's head—all are to be returned to their families in broad mercy."

s0268.literal: On yiwei day Qiao city surrendered.
s0268.idiomatic: On yiwei day Qiao city surrendered.

s0269.literal: On yisi day Prince Shuming was established as King of Yidu and Prince Shuxian as King of Hedong.
s0269.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince Shuming was made king of Yidu and Prince Shuxian king of Hedong.

s0270.literal: On renwu day Ren Zhong captured Huozhou city.
s0270.idiomatic: On renwu day Ren Zhong took Huozhou city.

s0271.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on renxu, the new moon, an edict said: "A king takes the four seas as his house and the myriad people as his children; if one thing is out of place, he is uneasy till evening; if the six directions are not united, he eats late with added care.
s0271.idiomatic: On renxu, the new moon of the first month of spring in year 6, an edict declared: "A king takes the four seas as his house and the myriad people as his children; if one thing goes wrong, he is uneasy at dusk; if the realm is not united, he eats late in added care.

s0272.literal: We have succeeded to the great foundation and think to enlarge the classic plan; above it matches the lodges of the stars, below it joins human counsel; We order generals to raise armies and greatly rescue those drowned in ruin.
s0272.idiomatic: We have inherited the great foundation and mean to enlarge the classic design; above it matches the star lodges, below it joins human counsel; We send generals to raise armies and rescue those drowning in ruin.

s0273.literal: The pitch-pipes have not yet made a full cycle, yet victories follow in succession; thousands of li of territory are opened, and cities about to number a hundred.
s0273.idiomatic: The pitch-pipes have not yet turned full circle, yet victories follow one another; thousands of li of territory are won, and cities near a hundred.

s0274.literal: The remnant folk are vicious in these strange lands; youths of Jiang and Huai still plunder; village scoundrels dig out private wrongs; commanders and soldiers heedless of the penal code—now let harsh laws be abolished and humane sound fill the roads.
s0274.idiomatic: The remnant people are fierce in these borderlands; youths of Jiang and Huai still raid; village bullies dig up private scores; commanders and soldiers ignore the law—now let harsh statutes be lifted and humane rule fill the roads.

s0275.literal: Moreover at the year's beginning good news was proclaimed and the border submitted in wild disorder; they first behold imperial wind and should receive deep grace—pardon the commoners of fifteen provinces: Jiang-right, north Huai, south Sizhou, Ding, Huo, Guang, Jian, Shuo, He, Yu, North Xu, Ren, North Yan, Qing, and Ji, and South Qiao and South Yan; Qizhou's Qi'an and Xiyang; Jiangzhou's Qichang, Xincai, and Gaotang; and South Yuzhou's Liyang and Linjiang commanderies, [16] crimes light or heavy, all are pardoned.
s0275.idiomatic: Moreover at the year's opening good news was proclaimed and the borders came in disorder; they first see imperial grace and should receive deep mercy—pardon the people of fifteen provinces: Jiang-right, north Huai, south Sizhou, Ding, Huo, Guang, Jian, Shuo, He, Yu, North Xu, Ren, North Yan, Qing, and Ji, and South Qiao and South Yan; Qizhou's Qi'an and Xiyang; Jiangzhou's Qichang, Xincai, and Gaotang; and South Yuzhou's Liyang and Linjiang, [16] crimes light or heavy, all forgiven.

s0276.literal: Commanders in office and soldiers who break the law are still judged by the usual code."
s0276.idiomatic: Commanders in office and soldiers who offend are still judged under the usual code."

s0277.literal: Assist-the-Van General Prince Bogu of Xin'an was made Central Army Commander and advanced to Secure Van General;
s0277.idiomatic: Bogu, Prince of Xin'an, assist-the-van general, was made central army commander and promoted to secure van general;

s0278.literal: Secure Van General and Central Army Commander Prince Bogong of Jin'an was made Secure South General and Inspector of South Yuzhou.
s0278.idiomatic: Bogong, Prince of Jin'an, secure van general and central army commander, was made secure south general and inspector of South Yuzhou.

s0279.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Grand Temple.
s0279.idiomatic: On renwu day the emperor sacrificed at the Grand Temple in person.

s0280.literal: On jiashen day Guangling's Jincheng surrendered.
s0280.idiomatic: On jiashen day Jincheng at Guangling surrendered.

s0281.literal: Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly mission.
s0281.idiomatic: Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0282.literal: The state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.

s0283.literal: In the second month, on renchen, the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
s0283.idiomatic: On renchen, the new moon of the second month, there was a solar eclipse.

s0284.literal: On xinhai day the imperial carriage personally plowed the sacred field.
s0284.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor plowed the sacred field in person.

s0285.literal: On jingchen day Central Authority Grand General, Opener of the Mansion Equal to the Three Dukes Chunyu Liang was made Campaign West Grand General and Inspector of Yingzhou.
s0285.idiomatic: On jingchen day Chunyu Liang, central authority grand general and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was made campaign west grand general and inspector of Yingzhou.

s0286.literal: In the third month, on guihai day, an edict said: "Last year the southern circuits widely reported poor harvests; the field tax they oversee has not yet been collected.
s0286.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai day, an edict declared: "Last year the southern circuits widely reported poor harvests; the field tax they oversee has not yet been collected.

s0287.literal: The field tax of Taijian year 5 for the six commanderies of Yuzhang may be deferred by half until autumn.
s0287.idiomatic: The Taijian year 5 field tax for the six commanderies of Yuzhang may be deferred by half until autumn.

s0288.literal: Yuzhang also still owes the inspected head-tax of Taijian year 4; this too is deferred until autumn.
s0288.idiomatic: Yuzhang also still owes the Taijian year 4 inspected head-tax; this too is deferred until autumn.

s0289.literal: For Nankang commandery alone, which links the ranges below and meets many needs, the Taijian year 4 field tax not yet paid may be specially remitted.
s0289.idiomatic: For Nankang commandery alone, which links the ranges below and bears heavy burdens, the unpaid Taijian year 4 field tax may be specially remitted.

s0290.literal: Thus cultivation may not be abandoned and the year's intake may be solid."
s0290.idiomatic: So that tillage may not be abandoned and the year's revenue may be sound."

s0291.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, a comet appeared.
s0291.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi day, a comet was seen.

s0292.literal: On xinchou day an edict said: "To curb feeling and cherish goodness is a ruler's fine model; to rescue the exhausted and save the endangered is a sage's universal teaching.
s0292.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict declared: "To curb feeling and cherish goodness is a ruler's fine model; to rescue the exhausted and save the endangered is a sage's universal teaching.

s0293.literal: Of late We ordered armies on a limited campaign with the meaning of helping the people; the old domains of Qing and Qi, the tribes of Jiao and Guang, long suffered from fierce barbarians and all turned to the Way; they abandoned farming and forgot food and clothing.
s0293.idiomatic: Lately We sent armies on a limited campaign to help the people; the old lands of Qing and Qi and the tribes of Jiao and Guang long suffered fierce enemies and all turned to the Way; they left farming and forgot food and clothing.

s0294.literal: Yet the great army had not yet joined them when they halted midway; at Qushan and Huangguo, wagon camps filled the ground; old and young, rootless and wandering, lost their livelihood and all became idlers; famine and plague could not but drive them to flight.
s0294.idiomatic: Yet the great army had not yet reached them when they halted midway; at Qushan and Huangguo wagon camps covered the ground; old and young wandered rootless, lost their livelihood, and became idlers; famine and plague drove them to flight.

s0295.literal: Let grand envoys be sent to comfort them carefully; still issue grain from the Yangping granary to save those at the end of their rope, and also supply seed grain.
s0295.idiomatic: Let grand envoys be sent to comfort them carefully; still issue grain from the Yangping granary to save those at the end of their rope and supply seed grain.

s0296.literal: Encourage men and women in farming and plant nearby fields.
s0296.idiomatic: Encourage men and women to farm and plant nearby fields.

s0297.literal: At Shibie and other garrisons, let them till as they see fit."
s0297.idiomatic: At Shibie and other garrisons, let them till as they see fit."

s0298.literal: On renchen day Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing and Concurrent Director of the Directorate of Education Zhou Hongzheng died.
s0298.idiomatic: On renchen day Zhou Hongzheng, right ministerial aide and concurrent director of the directorate of education, died.

s0299.literal: On yisi day Central Guard General and Inspector of Yangzhou Prince Boshan of Poyang was made Campaign North General and Inspector of South Xuzhou; Central Bulwark General Prince Boxin of Hengyang was made Pacify Campaigns General and Inspector of Yangzhou.
s0299.idiomatic: On yisi day Boshan, Prince of Poyang, central guard general and inspector of Yangzhou, was made campaign north general and inspector of South Xuzhou; Boxin, Prince of Hengyang, central bulwark general, was made pacify campaigns general and inspector of Yangzhou.

s0300.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on yihai day, an edict granted ten years of tax relief to all places where the northern campaign armies marched.
s0300.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yihai day, an edict granted ten years of tax relief to all places where the northern campaign armies marched.
